questions.q: Who received all that Abraham had?
questions.explain: To the sons of the concubines he gave gifts and sent them away; the inheritance followed the child of the promise.

questions.q: What prophecy did Rebekah receive when the children struggled within her?
choices: The younger shall serve the elder
One son will die in the wilderness
Two nations are in thy womb, and the elder shall serve the younger
questions.explain: Good is set against evil and the godly against the sinner (Ecclesiasticus 33:14-15).

questions.q: What does Jacob's hand holding Esau's heel mean, according to 2 Esdras 6?
choices: Jacob tried to stop Esau's birth
They were born at the same moment
Esau is the end of the world and Jacob the beginning of the one that follows
questions.explain: When Esau's rulership is done, Jacob comes into power; that is how we know the times.

questions.q: For what did Esau sell his birthright?
questions.explain: Therefore was his name called Edom, red. Thus Esau despised his birthright.

questions.q: How old was Isaac when he took Rebekah to wife?
questions.explain: Brothers waiting on a wife, be patient and stay virtuous; the Most High had the right sister appointed.
